grouping: Official train/test animal-identity split; recording/mouse groups saved in data.npz
terms: Current record CC BY 4.0; paper CC-BY-NC-SA 2.0 discrepancy. Raw data cache only, do not redistribute until resolved.
evaluation_regime: T3 code synthesis plus external supervised fitting
feature_description: Seven temporal offsets [-15,-5,-1,0,1,5,15] frames. At each offset flatten original keypoints shape(2 mice,2 coordinates x/y,7 landmarks) in C order: resident x landmarks0:7, resident y landmarks0:7, intruder x landmarks0:7, intruder y landmarks0:7. Landmark order nose,left ear,right ear,neck,left hip,right hip,tail base. Pose estimates are inputs; human behavior labels are targets. Do not smooth across examples or recording boundaries.
